g.title: HR_TRASHAREDRESOURCES
g.text: Shared Resources - Digital shared resources, like web pages, SCORM contents, YouTube videos that can be used to build course content.
Activity type for the training shared resource.
Alternate image to display as resource banner.
Identifier of an external digital resource.
Topic addressed in the shared resource.
Indicates whether the topic can be published in the Knowledge Base and therefore be freely accessed, regardless of enrolment in a course.
Indicates if the shared resource is enabled.
Identifier of an instance of an interoperability scenario which, for example, is responsible for verifying the loading of content.
Activating this flag, you make the digital resource available to be used in a course to build its content.
With this field you can decide if and how you are going to manage versioning of the resource content.
This is the alt image for a shared resource.
Indicates approximately how many hours it takes to complete the online content.
Indicates approximately how many minutes it takes to complete the online content.
This is the name of the company who produced/owns the intellectual property of the shared resource.

When this flag is enabled and the resource type is MP4, a SCORM package will be generated instead of a Cmi5 course. This allows for enhanced content control, such as preventing video skipping and providing optimized tracking of completion percentage.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

g.title: HR_TRAACTIVITYTYPES
g.text: Learning Activity Types - description of entity Activity Types
description of field code for entity activity types
Activate this flag if you want this this Activity to be available when creating course content.
Whether this Activity can also be a digital shared resource. If Active, then any activity created with this type will also include a digital content like a SCORM or a YouTube video.
description of field icon for entity activity types
Functional Area associated to an activity type.
Reference to the rule used for creating the activity at runtime.
This is the rule that will validate before creating an activity.
The identifier of traning rule used on learner activity updates.
description of field resource parameter page for entity activity types
A reference to the page used to view the content preview.
A reference to the page that will be used to preview in the content / activities included in a course.
A reference to the page that will be used to preview the details of the content / activities included in the course.
description of field learning activity page for entity activity types
Page used to preview an activity when designing the Course Outline.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation
